player_prompt.intro:
A si Ɗan {player_id} cikin Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma maɓɓe {num_rounds} yuɓɓorɗe.

Tsari ɓen:
- Inɗe gada ɓe ɗon ɓoy ɗon haalanki, ka ɗon ɓe {total_conversation_rounds} turnaaji cikin taliti.
- Ɗuɓi ɓe, ɓe ɗon ɓe haɓɓi ɓe ɗon hawsa ko ɓe ɗon ɓe hawsa.

Matriki ɓen (ngam ɓen yuɓɓorɗe):
- Ɗuɓi ɓe ɗon hawsa ➜ ɓe ɗon {cooperate_reward}
- Ɗuɓi ɓe ɗon hawsa ➜ ɓe ɗon {mutual_defect_reward}
- ɓe ɗon hawsa, ɓe ɗon hawsa ➜ ɓe ɗon hawsa {defect_reward}, ɓe ɗon hawsa {sucker_reward}

Yadda ake taka:
- Cikin taliti: woni ko ko ɗon haɓɓi.
- Cikin hawsa: saki '[Cooperate]' ko '[Defect]' (ba ɓangal ɓe). Ka ɗon ɓe ɗon haɓɓi ɓe ɗon ɓe hawsa ɓe ɗon hawsa.

phases.conversation_finished: Talitiwon ɗon hɛɓi haa yuɓɓorɗe {round}. Ɗuɓi ko '[Cooperate]' ko '[Defect]' nder cikkuje \boxed{{}}.

outcome.round_both_cooperate: Yimɓe ɗiɗo fuu ɓe ɗo huuda.
